strings.setting.persistence: Panel visibility, VSync and layout are saved automatically and on exit. A previous save is kept as Workspace.json.bak.
strings.setting.retry: Automatic saving is disabled. Save Workspace retries explicitly; Reload Workspace keeps current changes if loading fails.
strings.scene.preview: The central area shows the current render preview.
strings.scene.scope: Use Content Browser to build a source, then Build to instantiate the selected model. The central area previews the active scene.
strings.workspace.docking: Drag panel title bars to arrange the workspace. Use View to reopen panels.
strings.assets.outside_project: Directory is outside the project content root.
strings.assets.limit: Showing the first 512 entries; open a smaller folder to see more.
strings.inspector.file_scope: Open an author project and use Content Browser to import supported source files.
strings.status.load_failed: Workspace load failed; automatic saving is disabled
strings.status.save_failed: Workspace save failed; automatic saving is disabled
strings.build.preview_scope: Preview uses opaque two-sided Unlit base color. Authored materials stay in Model/Cooked data; PBR, texture shading and alpha evaluation follow later.
strings.build.image_scope: Sampled CPU image preview; original pixels and color-space tags are unchanged.
strings.content.open_project: Open an author project from File to select read-only source files.
strings.content.scope: glTF / GLB / FBX / OBJ and PNG / JPEG / TGA / BMP. Sources stay read-only; Cooked and DerivedDataCache are separate.
strings.dependencies.empty: Build an asset to inspect its dependency graph.
strings.project.path_hint: Enter the absolute path of a .catalpaproj author project.
